Note also that STACK itself records a residual gap OpenAI's asynchronous moderation does not close: even after flagging, 'the model is still able to provide one potentially dangerous answer to the user', and the authors bypassed conversation-linkage by exploiting KYC limitations — reinforcing Partial over Substantive.
